title: Ivan Bohdan
text:
Ivan Havrylovych Bohdan (Ukrainian: Іван Гаврилович Богдан; 29 February 1928 – 25 December 2020) was a Soviet and Ukrainian wrestler. He was born in Dmytro-Bilivka, Kryvyi Rih Okruha, Ukrainian SSR (today in Mykolaiv Oblast, not far from Kryvyi Rih).
He won an Olympic gold medal in Greco-Roman wrestling in 1960, competing for the Soviet Union. He won gold medals at the 1958 and 1961 World Wrestling Championships.
